decision.explanation: The query asks for the birth date of Maurice Roche, 4th Baron Fermoy. Source D1S1 and D1S2 explicitly state he was born on '15 May 1885'. Source D3S1 states he was born on '22 October 1885'. These are two distinct dates found in the provided text for the same entity, representing conflicting historical claims within the dataset. Source D2S1 contains a claim of '22 October 1900', but this contradicts the lifespan range (1885–1955) consistently cited in D1S1, D2S1 itself (which lists 1885-1955 in the header), and D3S1. Given the instruction to treat all sources as fallible and not to silently equate competing assertions, both 15 May 1885 and 22 October 1885 are preserved as valid extracted answers from the text, while 22 October 1900 is rejected due to internal inconsistency with the provided lifespan data.
